_comment: The POSITIVE half of the Coldsteel Heart colour-lock pair (see
coldsteel_heart_color_locked.json for the full rationale and the user report).
Identical board except ONE Coldsteel Heart is pinned BLUE instead of green, so the board makes
{G} (Forest) + {U} (blue Heart) + {G} (green Heart) and Ice-Fang Coatl's {G}{U} IS payable.
This is the half that proves the lock is a RESTRICTION and not a refusal: a source pinned to a
colour must actually PAY that colour. Without it, a bug that made every etb_choose_color
permanent produce nothing at all would still pass the negative fixture.
